At our town hall in Johnstown, Trump voters, independents, & Democrats sat down for a respectful dialogue. There was disagreement on immigration and crime.

What we agreed on was a billionaire tax, fixing our broken healthcare system & bringing manufacturing jobs back to America.
posts.summary: Emphasizes shared support for billionaire tax, healthcare reform, manufacturing jobs

posts.text:
Built in 1852, Cambria Iron Works 
in Johnstown is one of the oldest steel plants. It become Bethlehem Steel in 1923. After the mills closed in 1992, over 12,000 workers lost their jobs.

Trump promised to bring steel back to Johnstown. He did not deliver. My Steel Modernization bill calls for an investment in 8 modern steel plants in deindustrialized towns like Johnstown.
posts.summary: Criticizes Trump's unfulfilled steel manufacturing promise, proposes modernization bill

Yesterday, I met with workers in Erie. Trump told them he would make Erie a manufacturing superpower and bring them sand to prevent erosion from the lake. The record -- no manufacturing jobs, no sand.  Erie has lost manufacturing jobs and Trump has refused to fund the sand they need.

In Pittsburgh, I met with Rep. @ChrisForPA and joined a roundtable discussion with USW workers on how we can increase union density by demanding labor neutrality from federal contractors and grant recipients.

SEIU

This week, I will be touring Pennsylvania to meet with workers and communities and lay out a plan for a New Economic Patriotism. We need the future economy working not just for a few, but for all of us.

For our first stop, I joined @chrisrabb in Philadelphia to discuss a New Deal for the 21st century.
posts.summary: Advocates economic policy benefiting workers and communities, not wealthy few

posts.text:
Rural voters in Meadville, Pennsylvania are worried about being able to afford a home. They’re demanding answers on how to protect jobs from getting replaced with AI. Their hospitals are losing funding while medical bills are piling up. Their elementary schools are closing.

A 21st century New Deal for our time- for an economic and moral restoration of this country- means Medicare for All and taxing billionaires to pay for it. It means money for our schools, our infrastructure, our manufacturing
posts.summary: Calls for New Deal-style intervention to protect rural jobs and services

In rural Erie, PA, there is only one private practice pediatrician left in the community. Not many years ago, there were 20.

I stood on the picket line with frontline healthcare workers from Mount Nittany Medical Center to fight for a fair contract in which wages keep up with inflation. 

It is cruel that the hospital has taken away workers' health insurance to punish them for striking.
